feature: Post-seek timeout recovery, PCM timestamp synchronization and Series SxEx episode labels
user_evidence: Uploaded console log contains two media inactivity/I-O errors after stream restarts, with audio underruns; user reports audio plays ahead. Raw log and private paths are not published. The log cannot establish the server-side cause of the delivery gaps.

changes.HTTP: Media response/body idle30s rather than8s; connect/send idle8s and control API8s idle/20s total retained. Remote probe/open60s, local15s.100ms cancellation polling retained. Real30s inactivity fails clearly; no infinite wait/retry.
changes.audio: FIFO is anchored at the seek origin, includes timestamp gaps as bounded queued silence, trims overlaps and accounts for resampler delay. Append waits check stop/serial before writing. Adds gap/overlap diagnostics. No codec, SIMD, worker or GPU algorithm change.
changes.labels: Immutable Resume/NextUp labels use Series Name S1E2 - Episode Name. Jellyfin season/episode presence is tracked so specials/episode0 work; missing numbers fall back to series/title. Existing prefixes normalized, raw metadata/movie/nested titles retained,352byte bounded labels.
changes.retained: Shared media roots and existing paths unchanged, no migration; local byte seeking, Jellyfin negotiation/cleanup, decoder workers/DSP and GPU display retained.
changes.licence: GPLv3 combined executable with complete corresponding source/build scripts, pinned free SDK and original licences/artwork attribution.
